name: 予定と記録時間の相違
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse LH11-0022 予定と記録時間の相違 notice. Image1 ORIGINAL Deputy source controls warning/chevron glyph geometry, optical weight, proportions, alignment, spacing and fine controls. Image2 Japanese mock is SECONDARY localized content/layout reference; do not copy its thin outline warning triangle or rough oversized chevron. Image3 approved bus is white surface/depth style only.
Render only a compact single horizontal notice at logical640x58 proportions on pure white #FFFFFF canvas. WHITE rounded rectangle with fine neutral border, restrained soft downward shadow, no broad gray/mint fill. At left small FILLED RED WARNING TRIANGLE with WHITE exclamation mark, faithful original silhouette and optical proportions, about12–14logicalpx beside14px text. Then exact modest-bold Meiryo14/24 message 「予定と記録が異なります」. Immediately after message a SMALL DOWNWARD CHEVRON in coherent slate #526173, original compact V geometry, about8–10logicalpx, indicating collapsed detail. At far right forest-green text action 「予定の時刻に戻す」, Meiryo regular12/16. Align glyphs, label and action on one clean baseline with compact useful spacing and readable margins.
Preserve exact Japanese copy, warning state, collapsed detail control and revert action. Source red is a real discrepancy warning: retain readable #B42318 triangle with white exclamation. Original purple interactive action becomes forest-green #1F6444; utility chevron slate. No decorative accent or random colors. No new close X, icons, buttons, times, metrics, app chrome or explanatory subtitle. Meiryo/zero tracking/locked hierarchy, white surfaces, quiet elevation; no heavy gloss, glow or tinted page. Static raster candidate only, no actual time reset or interactive behavior claimed.
reviewNotes: 日本語/復元リンク/下シェブロン/白面を保持し原画の塗り警告三角を復元。生成三角が本文より大きく原画の光学比率を超え、赤も明るく光沢があるため、記号の大きさと赤色のみ修正必要。画像修正待ち、実動作未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
